narrative.summary: CORRECTED 2026-09-19 (71 to 22): TIMELOCK_ADMIN on the live RoleStore includes a bare EOA (GMX’s own timelock_admin_2) that can queue a grant of ANY role through TimelockConfig and execute it after 24h. The 5-of-8 Safe can only veto (cancel / revokeRole).
narrative.tag: CORRECTION: a single key starts the clock
narrative.detail: The earlier score checked a ConfigTimelockController (0xC77E…) that holds no role on the live RoleStore. The live ROLE_ADMIN holders are the GMX DAO timelock, ConfigTimelockController 0x2Dd99f39… and TimelockConfig 0xE7706986… (both Sourcify-verified), all with a 24h delay. Verified on 2 RPCs. See chains/arbitrum-ecosystem/data/rotation_audit_2026-09-19-index0-gmx-rolestore.md. Pushed on-chain 2026-09-20 (composite 22 to 19, Arbitrum Sepolia block 310866307): the GMX DAO timelock 0x4bd1cdAa…, the other ROLE_ADMIN timelock (24h), has a second bare EOA (0xE7BfFf2a…) holding PROPOSER, EXECUTOR and CANCELLER next to the Governor contract, and the 5-of-8 Safe holds none of those roles there; a schedule of a ROLE_ADMIN grant simulates fine from that EOA and reverts from a random address and from the Safe. So a single key can queue and, after 24h, execute a grant with no Governor vote and no Safe veto, and the veto credit drops (timelock 60 to 50). Admin and multisig were already at the bare-EOA floor.

cheapest_fix.what: a confirmed delay before changes apply
